primary_unit: accepted DATA-003 transaction-condition episode anchored to exact venue transaction_hash + active token_id

chronology.pre_fill_rule: book state must be strictly earlier than linked trade in (timestamp_received, sequence) order
chronology.equal_receive_time: eligible only when sequence proves book event earlier than trade

book_reconstruction.delta_event: price_change updates or deletes one BUY/SELL price level
book_reconstruction.replenishment_definition: recovery of fixed consumed-side 2c price band relative to its strictly pre-trade visible depth

matched_control.sampling: first valid reconstructed state in each 5-minute token bucket
matched_control.exclusion: remove controls within 60 seconds of any linked accepted fill on that token
matched_control.matching: same window and token; nearest standardized state using mid, spread, log 2c depth, and 60s book-update activity
matched_control.primary_contrast: aggressor-signed 30s and 300s mid move: fill minus matched non-fill control

primary_candidates.hypothesis: episode size normalized by visible touch liquidity explains 30s signed response better than absolute episode size
primary_candidates.eligible_rows: exact venue price+size economic matches only
primary_candidates.dev_gate: relative-size model DEV R2 > absolute-size model DEV R2 and relative-size DEV R2 > 0

primary_candidates.hypothesis: failure to recover 80% of pre-trade consumed-side 2c depth within 30s is associated with larger aggressor-direction continuation
primary_candidates.dev_gate: DEV mean signed 30s move for failed-replenishment episodes exceeds recovered episodes

primary_candidates.hypothesis: fills move further than comparable non-fill states
primary_candidates.dev_gate: at least 50 DEV matched pairs and token-cluster bootstrap 2.5% bound of fill-minus-control signed 30s move > 0

secondary_challengers: 60s signed trade flow and VPIN-like imbalance
venue size divided by touch liquidity
flow persistence after the anchored fill
promotion_rule: secondary challengers are descriptive unless they show stable TRAIN-to-DEV improvement; they cannot be added to the B0 shortlist by post-DEV threshold invention
b0_rule: B0 is not read by the V3 core. Only candidates frozen in PRE_HOLDOUT_FREEZE.json may be evaluated once on B0.
